text:
Marta: Quick thought: our current error surface is overloaded — same HTTP codes used for different routing and billing signals. Can we introduce 'signal buckets' (ok, retryable, capacity-limited, quota-exceeded, unauthorized) that map to headers + telemetry, while keeping stable status codes for clients?

Sam: Curious — how's that different from existing 'throttle' vs 'fallback' semantics? Need a concrete mapping table.

Marta: High-level: expose a small, orthogonal signal via header `X-RI-Signal` and a short `user_hint` in body. SDKs and the console read the header for automated decisions. Example enums: `ok`, `retryable`, `capacity-limited`, `quota-exceeded`, `unauthorized`.

Eli: I like header-first. SDKs can back off based on it. Important: we should not break clients that only look at HTTP codes — so keep codes meaningful for hard failures. For transient behavior prefer 429/503 with header details.

Aisha: Observability note: we should emit one metric `signals.count` with a `signal` tag, not explode with many different error names. That keeps dashboards compact.

Jon: +1. Also attach `signal_reason` (short enum) and `signal_origin` (router/dedicated/private) to traces — lightweight labels.

Marta: Quick example response we might standardize on:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
X-RI-Signal: quota-exceeded
X-RI-Retry-After: 12
Content-Type: application/json

{"error":"quota_exceeded","user_hint":"quota exhausted for this org, see console > quotas"}
```

Priya: Console UX: Show a "signal timeline" per route (bars for ok/retryable/capacity/quota) and, on hover, an action card with concrete mitigations. Avoid generic 'error' language — prefer action phrases.

Sam: Rollout ops: we need feature flags so SDKs can opt in to header parsing. SDK vX can default to header-aware behavior; older SDKs continue status-code-only.

Eli: Telemetry detail: increment `signal.bucket` counter for every response, sample detailed payloads (headers + route) at a low rate for debugging. Keep tag cardinality low.

deploy-bot: patch `feature/signal-headers` deployed to staging at 2026-03-19T15:04Z :rocket: 

Aisha: Proposed migration plan: 1) add headers + metrics (no change to user-facing copy), 2) expose header docs + console surface, 3) SDK opt-ins, 4) flip default parsing after two weeks of stable metrics.

Jon: Timeline?

Marta: Suggest canary next week, global after 2 weeks of stable signals.

Sam: I'll open an RFC PR with the mapping table, header names, and sample SDK pseudocode.

Priya: Also plan for copy: short, actionable lines. Eg: "quota-exceeded — reduce batch size or request higher quota in the console." Keep it tiny.

Marta: Great. Tagging @docs-team and @sdk-team for review. Thanks everyone.
